reviews.text: We brought our dog here, Sugar, because we trust the vet, Dr. White who has been standing in at our home vet in Plano.  She has impressed us with the work she has done thus far with our puppy and we trust her.  She has helped us diagnose her issues and given us a path forward.  We will be going to Pet Vet going forward because we trust Dr. White.  We took her for a sonogram to check her liver as this was only one of several issues she had going on.
Excellent doctor friendly staff have a lot of confidence in this place.
Took 45 min for appt, Dr not good with cats, and pricier than other clinics.

We've been taking Milo to Pet Vet, and the care he receives has been exceptional. Dr. Kapu is knowledgeable, compassionate, and always takes the time to explain everything clearly. He genuinely cares about his patients and treats Milo with kindness and attention at every visit.

The entire team is friendly, professional, and welcoming, making every appointment a positive experience. We always leave feeling confident that Milo is in the best hands. Thank you, Dr. Kapu and everyone at Pet Vet for taking such wonderful care of Milo. We highly recommend Pet Vet to anyone looking for excellent veterinary care.

We have brought our 3 dogs here for years. When we went in today it was anything but pleasant. Our dog has bad skin allergies. The vet gave him two shots and then said we needed to get him a prescription shampoo and a prescription diet as well as an allergy panel. We were not told the prices of anything before they tried to push it on us. We told them we would get the shots and wait on the shampoo to not over do it. Our dog got the shots and when we tried to walk out to go pay they said wait let me get the shampoo. They brought back the shampoo and we asked how much and they said $50. We said no thanks. The allergy panel was offered at over $600. No clue how much the prescription food cost and the shots were over $300. We were shamed for trying to help our dog by giving him an oatmeal bath and using oatmeal shampoo and then we were shamed for putting a shirt on him to keep him from scratching. As we were paying one of the ladies looked through the glass and gave us a mean look because we wouldn’t buy the shampoo. Awful experience.

I’ve been bringing my cat to this vet for a couple years, but I’m really disappointed after my most recent visit. I brought my cat in for an exam, paid the exam fees, and then was told she needed to be switched to a prescription diet temporarily. The food they recommended costs $70–$100 for 24 cans, whether you get it at their clinic or online.

I found a trusted online retailer offering the same food for half the price, but when I asked for a written prescription to order it elsewhere, they told me it would be an additional $20 fee — just for the script. This is after already paying for the exam.

I understand businesses need to make money, but charging extra to give pet owners access to more affordable options feels wrong. It makes it harder to provide proper care, and I honestly don’t understand how this is ethical. We’re trying to do what’s best for our pets, and it’s disappointing to feel like we’re being nickel-and-dimed for it. With this kind of treatment, I’ve decided to switch vets and take my business elsewhere.

Their demeanor was friendly and professional, and they all took care and time to explain to me how they were assessing my dog, and what their opinions were on her injury.
I *highly* recommend this vet practice for anyone in Farmers Branch or Addison or anywhere near the Spring Valley/Midway intersection. They are first class vet clinic.
